hikes.name: Jefferson Park via Whitewater
hikes.blurb: One of Oregon's finest alpine parks: lake-dotted meadows right at the foot of Mt Jefferson's north face.

hikes.name: Jefferson Park via South Breitenbush
hikes.blurb: The quieter, steeper way into Jefferson Park, past a gorge on the South Breitenbush River.

hikes.name: Pamelia Lake and Grizzly Peak
hikes.blurb: Old forest to a green lake under Mt Jefferson, then up to a summit staring straight at the peak (limited-entry permit).

hikes.name: Sahalie and Koosah Falls Loop
hikes.blurb: Both banks of the upper McKenzie River between two thundering falls over young lava.

hikes.name: Clear Lake Loop
hikes.blurb: Around a lake so cold and clear you can see a drowned forest on its bottom, past the spring that feeds the McKenzie.

hikes.name: Iron Mountain Lookout
hikes.blurb: A famous wildflower slope and a summit lookout with the Cascades from Hood to the Sisters.

hikes.name: Coffin Mountain Lookout
hikes.blurb: A short climb through beargrass to a working fire lookout on a flat-topped peak.

hikes.name: Patjens Lakes Loop
hikes.blurb: A burned-forest loop from Big Lake to a set of small lakes under Mt Washington.

hikes.name: Duffy Lake
hikes.blurb: Along the North Santiam through recovering burn to a lake with Duffy Butte rising behind.

hikes.name: Middle Pyramid
hikes.blurb: Up past meadows and a small lake to an old lookout site on a steep-sided peak in the Old Cascades.

hikes.name: Browder Ridge
hikes.blurb: A lonely Old Cascades ridge of rock gardens and summer flowers.

hikes.name: Carl Lake
hikes.blurb: Through a big burn on Jefferson's east side to a deep blue lake under a cliff.

hikes.name: Three Fingered Jack via the PCT
hikes.blurb: North on the Pacific Crest Trail to the ridge under Three Fingered Jack's crumbling spires.

hikes.name: Canyon Creek Meadows
hikes.blurb: Wildflower meadows climbing toward Three Fingered Jack's jagged east face and a glacial cirque.

hikes.name: Marion Lake and Marion Falls
hikes.blurb: A gentle climb to a big lake with Three Fingered Jack beyond and a two-tier falls just below its outlet.

hikes.name: Triangulation Peak and Boca Cave
hikes.blurb: A short ridge walk to a rocky summit and a hidden cave framing Mt Jefferson.

hikes.name: Square Lake
hikes.blurb: A short walk off Santiam Pass to a lake with Three Fingered Jack's south face above.

hikes.name: Hoodoo Butte
hikes.blurb: From Patjens Lake Trailhead, a 6.4-mile round trip to the top of Hoodoo Butte (5,686 ft), with about 1,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Santiam Lake
hikes.blurb: From Duffy Lake Trailhead, a 9.4-mile round trip to Santiam Lake, with about 1,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Heart Lake
hikes.blurb: From Gate Creek Trailhead, a 9.0-mile round trip to Heart Lake, with about 2,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Tumble Falls
hikes.blurb: From Tumble Creek Trailhead - North, a 2.2-mile round trip to Tumble Falls, with about 900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sad Lake
hikes.blurb: From Marion Lake Trailhead, a 9.2-mile round trip to Sad Lake, with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Bear Point
hikes.blurb: From South Breitenbush Trailhead, a 7.4-mile round trip to the top of Bear Point (6,027 ft), with about 2,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lake of the Woods
hikes.blurb: From Marion Lake Trailhead, a 9.9-mile round trip to Lake of the Woods, with about 1,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Melis Lake
hikes.blurb: From Marion Lake Trailhead, an 8.3-mile round trip to Melis Lake, with about 1,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Maxwell Lake
hikes.blurb: From Maxwell Butte Trailhead, a 6.6-mile round trip to Maxwell Lake, with about 1,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Crescent Lake
hikes.blurb: From Crescent Mountain North/South Pyramid Trailhead, a 5.9-mile round trip to Crescent Lake, with about 1,600 feet of climbing.
